invariants: only enabled public product-owned commands may be probed or executed
compatibility aliases resolve to the one canonical command
every operation reads the current live command table
unknown disabled private extension-owned and stale commands are refused
probes return false for malformed ids
execution validates ids and counts before checking liveness
counts are positive integers no greater than 10000

nativeProtocolAdaptation.productNamespace: workdeck replaces hunk in public command ids
nativeProtocolAdaptation.probe: each command keyboard-mode and dialog-continuation callback receives the enabled canonical ids and aliases from the current live Ratatui table
nativeProtocolAdaptation.execution: the SDK constructs a declarative action only for an enabled id and the host validates it again before dispatch
nativeProtocolAdaptation.liveness: extension command epochs discard actions returned by retired review handlers
